% Pattern: number/reset. \@addtoreset and \newcounter[...] reset a counter
% and leave its format as it is, so the theorem of a class that resets it by
% chapter, in a paper with no chapters, prints 1 and not 0.1. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2
% want step-1 statement/lemma 1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{step}{Lemma}
\makeatletter
\newcounter{chapter}
\@addtoreset{theorem}{chapter}
\newcounter{part}[section]
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Every point is closed. \end{theorem}
\section{Two}
\begin{theorem} Every line is closed. \end{theorem}
\begin{step} Every plane is closed. \end{step}
\end{document}
